description: Defines functions for constructing various precoding weight matrices used in MIMO transmission, including configurations for different numbers of layers and ports, with specific focus on 3GPP TS38.214 standard parameters.

methods.name: make_single_port
methods.description: Constructs a precoder configuration for a single transmitter port.

methods.name: make_one_layer_one_port
methods.description: Constructs a precoding weight matrix for one layer mapped into one transmit port.

methods.name: make_identity
methods.description: Constructs a scaled identity precoding weight matrix for a given number of streams.

methods.name: make_one_layer_all_ports
methods.description: Constructs a precoding weight matrix for one layer mapped into all transmit ports, generating identical signals.

methods.name: make_one_layer_two_ports
methods.description: Constructs a precoding weight matrix for one layer mapped into two transmit ports based on a codebook.

methods.name: make_two_layer_two_ports
methods.description: Constructs a precoding weight matrix for two layers mapped into two transmit ports based on a codebook.

methods.name: make_one_layer_four_ports_type1_sp_mode1
methods.description: Constructs a precoding weight matrix for one layer mapped into four ports with specific beam and polarization parameters.

methods.name: make_two_layer_four_ports_type1_sp_mode1
methods.description: Constructs a precoding weight matrix for two layers mapped into four ports with specific beam and polarization parameters.

methods.name: make_three_layer_four_ports_type1_sp
methods.description: Constructs a precoding weight matrix for three layers mapped into four ports with specific beam and polarization parameters.

methods.name: make_four_layer_four_ports_type1_sp
methods.description: Constructs a precoding weight matrix for four layers mapped into four ports with specific beam and polarization parameters.
